title: Spicy Korean Sesame Cucumber Salad
summary: A crisp, refreshing cucumber salad inspired by Korean oi muchim, with chilli heat, toasted sesame flavour and a tangy-savoury dressing. It makes a light vegan lunch or a punchy side for rice and tofu.
steps: Put the sliced cucumber in a bowl, sprinkle with the salt and toss well. Leave for 10 minutes until the cucumber has softened slightly and released some liquid.
Meanwhile, mix the tamari, rice vinegar, sesame oil, sugar, chilli powder and grated garlic in a large bowl until the sugar dissolves.
Drain the cucumber well and gently squeeze out excess liquid with clean hands or a tea towel. The slices should still be crisp but not watery.
Add the cucumber and spring onions to the dressing and toss until every slice is glossy and evenly coated.
Sprinkle over the sesame seeds, toss once more, then serve immediately for maximum crunch, or chill for 10 minutes for a colder salad.
